$comment: The audio control's own words, in both languages.
These belong in `src/i18n/ui.ts` with the rest of the shell's chrome, and they
should move there. They are here because the translation lane owns `src/i18n/**`
and is mid-change: `t()` checks its keys at compile time, so adding rows to
`UI` from this lane would be a conflict in the one file that lane is rewriting.
JSON rather than a `.ts` module on purpose. `src/i18n/__tests__/coverage.test.ts`
fails the suite for a Chinese string literal anywhere under `src/**/*.ts(x)`, and
it is right to: a hardcoded string is a string the language toggle cannot reach.
This file is read through the same `useLanguage()` subscription the toggle drives,
so switching language repaints it like everything else.
To adopt: move each row into `UI` under the same key, delete this file, and swap
`label(lang, k)` for `t(k)` in GameAudio.tsx. Nothing else changes.

audio.voice.count.en_US: {n} recorded lines, fetched as they are needed.
